answer: Tasks are generated by domain-separated hashing of the prompt with a future drand quicknet round. Its threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before release, unbiasable, and publicly verifiable, so cached solutions cannot be prepared in advance. A yarrow-seeded voyage can define task context, while an ember nonce binds each answer to its round and claimant. Sybil swarms must therefore perform fresh work after the pulse; this raises farming costs but does not replace identity controls.
